newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index falls sharply.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index falls sharply.

text.p: Stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index fell sharply in the latest week, down 136.2 points or 4.1 percent as speculators fled on Friday when the wider market came under selling pressure. The all ordinaries index ended 3.12 percent lower.
Dec 6 Nov 29 pct 1 Month pct 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.

After almost three weeks of euphoria, the small resources sector came to earth with a thud in waves of selling, an absence of buying support saw falls outnumber gains by three to one, Eyres Reed analyst Glen Colgan said in a commentary.

Gainers included Indonesian offshore diamond explorer Ocean Resources NL, up 4.5 cents to 30.5 cents in anticipation of results; Diamin Resources NL (Ocean's neighbour in Indonesia) was up 0.6 cents to five cents; Nugold Hill Mines NL up 1.5 cents to 13 cents and Lynas Gold NL up two cents to 19.5 cents following its major shareholder offloading its holding.

Falls dominated: Helix Resources NL down 65 cents to A$2.70, Equinox Resources NL lost 17 cents to 65 cents, Goldstream Mining NL down nine cents to 48 cents, and Striker Resources NL fell 5.5 cents to 16.5 cents after trading higher during the week.
